title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1973-04-02

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of an early Boston Garden show, praised for its nostalgic energy despite a one‑track offset.
ai_review.review: Listeners recall this as many people's first Dead concert experience – the excitement of NRPS opening at Boston Garden and the youthful buzz of a late‑70s crowd. The recording is generally regarded as decent (soundboard source) but suffers from a minor track‑order error, which does not detract much from its overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are uniformly enthusiastic about the show’s atmosphere and give solid (4‑5 star) ratings; the only technical complaint is a one‑track offset, so overall rating settles around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard recording; however, track order is off by one song, causing a minor sequencing issue.
